title: Find the problem point
text: The integrand is undefined at $$x=3$$, which is inside the interval from $$2$$ to $$4$$. Split the integral at $$x=3$$.

title: Check one piece
text: The integral from $$2$$ to $$t$$ is $$\frac{-1}{t-3}-1$$. As $$t$$ approaches $$3$$ from the left, this goes to $$\infty$$, so the whole integral diverges.
